# Quint-IA Vantage

> Quint-IA Vantage is an answer engine optimization (AEO) agency for LatAm-founded B2B companies (SaaS, nearshore software and services, exporters; 10 to 150 employees) that sell to US buyers. We get clients cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews when US buyers ask which vendor to hire.

Based in Latin America, working in English and Spanish. AEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) are the same work. We do not guarantee citations or rankings.

## Offers and prices (USD)

- Quick-Start Blueprint: $500 one-time. AI visibility diagnostic across ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity against named competitors, plus a prioritized 90-day action plan. Fee credits toward month one of any retainer signed within 30 days.
- Foundation Retainer: $950/month, 3-month minimum. Technical audit, schema specs, knowledge graph seed, 2 AEO content pieces per month, monthly report.
- Momentum Retainer: $1,750/month, 6-month minimum. Full four-pillar program, 4 to 5 content pieces per month, Reddit and Quora presence, weekly prompt tracking, monthly strategy call.
- Citation Engine Retainer: $2,750/month, 6-month minimum. Everything in Momentum plus comparison pages, FAQ program, stat content, YouTube scripts, weekly tracking across 4 answer engines, quarterly competitive analysis.
